title: Page 8
content_zh:
“今晚……”在他即将进入的时候，温宁忽然搂住他的手臂，“轻一点，好吗？”
肖崇源心头一软，爱怜地吻了吻她的耳垂，“好，今晚我们只做一次。”
他们紧紧地拥抱了好一会才分开，分开之后肖崇源又留恋地贴上去，搂着她磨蹭。
但温宁有了力气之后，却轻轻地拂开了他的手……
“温宁，你睡过就不认帐了是吧！”第二天一大早，肖崇源就对着浴室门叫个不停。今天醒来之后，温宁根本不承认昨晚答应他要重新在一起的事，嘴硬地说是自己一时糊涂。
一时糊涂？她是爽糊涂了才对吧，面对他的质问，温宁却不理不睬，迳自跑进浴室洗澡，无情地把他关在门外，还把水流开到最大，掩盖住他怒气冲冲的声音。
肖崇源唠叨了半天得不到回应，他气急地敲门，“你这是在欺骗我的身体！”
话音刚落，浴室的门忽然被
肖崇源一时噎住，“那个……”
“吃亏的明明是我才对吧。”温宁擦着头发走出来，赤着脚走进厨房，留下一地湿脚印。
“穿鞋，不知道冷吗？”肖崇源拧眉跟过去，走到厨房门口便见她她的身材比例那样完美，每，根脚趾都白嫩干净，还带着一层淡淡的粉。
“看什么？”
“没什么……”肖崇源这才发觉自己居然盯着她的脚看。
“你该去上班了。”温宁捧着冰淇淋又晃了出去。
“你不说清楚，我哪都不去。”肖崇源不依不饶地跟着温宁来到沙发上，“反正你不也要靠复婚来拿回证件吗，眼看你姐订的期限快到了，我们假戏真做不是正好？”
“我们有合约的。”温宁
“合约？”
“是啊，合约上写得很清楚，我们假复婚三个月，这期间我照顾你的生活起居，期满后井水不犯河水。”温宁将一勺冰淇淋填入口中，心中不满地咀嚼着。
其实昨天半夜她就醒来了，看着身边熟睡的男人思忖了好一会，才回亿起晚上发生的事，他说要重新开始，难道他之前对自己的恶劣行径就这样一笔勾销了吗？虽然听他这么说她很心动……
听她这样说，肖崇源知道她是在呕气，于是耸肩说：“那都是我随口说说的，你知道，我向来喜欢骗……喜欢逗你的。”

温宁含着勺子看他一眼，他自己都说喜欢骗她了，谁知道这次是不是又一时兴起要骗她玩？
“阿宁，你怎么不说话了？”肖崇源的声音唤回她的思绪。
“我……”温宁用勺子搅了搅冰淇淋，低声说：“我并不想真的复婚。”
“别呕气了。”
“我没有。”温宁有些恼怒。
“你对我也是有感觉的，对不对？前两晚你的反应已经说明了一切。”
肖崇源笃定地看着她，“你两次把我错叫成老公，潜意识是不能骗人的。”
温宁被问住，双手紧紧地抱着冰淇淋桶，似乎无法再继续假装无所谓。
肖崇源胸有成竹地看着她，“复婚吧，阿宁，这也是你想要的，不是吗？”
“不，这不是！”像是被他看穿了，温宁瞬间爆发出来，她骤然拔高的音量吓了肖崇源一跳。
“阿宁……”
“那样冰冷的婚姻，我不想再经历一次了。”温宁的肩膀有些颤抖，“不要摆出一副你很了解我的模样，如果你真的了解，就该知道当初我根本不想要一个没有爱的婚姻，收起你的胸有成竹，你不知道，你根本什么都不知道！”
“阿宁……”肖崇源感到惊讶，同时也觉得有些心痛，“但我……我现在爱你。”他试图把手放到她颤抖的肩膀上，却被她闪开了。
温宁抓着自己的肩膀抬头，眼中的泪水里满是指控，“这就够了吗？你不爱我，就可以轻轻松松地离婚，等你爱上我，我再兴高采烈地跑来和你复婚，肖崇源，我没有那么廉价！”
“我不是这个意思，只是你为什么会……这么厌恶我？我以为你对我也是有感觉的。”
“不，我只是厌恶我自己，厌恶这个没办法讨厌你的自己。”
温宁的声音又低下来，她有些无助地闪开目光，又挖了一勺冰淇淋含入口中，香草奶油蹭到她的唇瓣上，很快又被滚滚滑下的泪水冲散，“如果两年之前你肯爱上我，或许我就不会经历那么多难熬的日子。”她一面大口大口地吃冰淇淋，一面流泪。
她的嘴巴被塞满，却因为哽咽吞不下去，冰得脸色发白。
“别这样，阿宁。”肖崇源焦灼地伸手夺过冰淇淋桶，抽出卫生纸捧着送到她唇下，哑声说：“吐出来，不要冰到自己。”
肖崇源看到那双蓄满了泪水的眼眸看过来，满眼的指控令他心头发紧，温宁看着他，忽然哭着呛了几下，将口中的冰淇淋都吐了出来。

没有了阻挡，她捂着脸开始嘤嘤地哭，肖崇源几次想要安慰她，却不知道该如何开口。
等了好一会，温宁的哭声才渐渐弱下去，她抱着膝盖不停抽噎，断断续续地开口说：“你曾问我，既然蒙娜都可以忍，为什么当初……不肯多忍耐你。”她有些失神地看着一处，“是因为那时我爱上你了，所以我无法忍受丈夫的冷漠，知道我是什么时候爱上你的吗？”
陷入回忆的温宁竟然扬起一抹若有似无的笑容，“其实我也忘记了，或许是第一次见面，你问我是不是很饿的时候，或许是结婚后，你对我说我笑起来其实很漂亮的时候……为什么你那时不肯爱我？在我为你学做饭、学做家务时，不肯多爱我一点？你的爱整整迟了三年，我为什么要接受，在我终于放下过去的时候？”
温宁声声控诉像是一把把刀，插进肖崇源的心脏，他竟然完全没有察觉到她的心意，他一直以为彼此对这段婚姻的看法，仅仅是门当户对而已。
原来温宁这么苦苦地等着他爱上自己，而他呢？居然还在责怪温宁，怪她性情大变、怪她决绝地离婚，怪不得温宁不愿忍耐，因为他根本不值得。
“对不起。”满满的愧疚与心痛，令肖崇源除了道歉以外无话可说。
温宁只是摇了摇头，没有再说什么，沉默地起身走进客房。
这段突如其来的告白，令肖崇源感觉到前所未有的恐惧，他好怕温宁会报复自己，在他终于动心的时候再次决然离去，让他好好体会一下等待的滋味。
这时肖崇源才完全确认自己对温宁的心意，他不想离开她，不想再过一次没有她的生活，他爱上她已经成了毋庸置疑的现实。
一个小时后，肖崇源轻轻敲了敲客房的门，没有得到回应，他便试探性地拧了拧门把，发现门没有锁之后，就轻手轻脚地走了进去。
温宁站在窗边，纤弱的背影令人心疼，肖崇源走过去，不由自主地从身后搂住她，用力得好像生怕她会跑掉似的，不过幸好温宁没有抗拒。
肖崇源把头埋进温宁的颈窝，哑声说：“都是我的错，再给我一次机会，让我好好爱你，我爱你，阿宁。”
肖崇源搂着她，一遍遍说着情话，声音是无法抑制的颤抖。
温宁透过窗子的倒影，看着身后眼眶发红的男人，她知道自己根本没办法拒绝他，即使歇斯底里地说不会再上当，但她也知道自己抗拒不了他。
content_en:
"Tonight..." Just as he was about to enter, Wen Ning suddenly hugged his arm, "Be gentle, okay?"
Xiao Chongyuan's heart softened, and he kissed her earlobe lovingly, "Okay, we will only do it once tonight."
They hugged her tightly for a while before they separated. After they separated, Xiao Chongyuan clung to her nostalgically, hugging her and rubbing against her.
But after Wen Ning gained strength, she gently brushed his hand away...
"Wen Ning, you won't admit it after you slept, right?" Early the next morning, Xiao Chongyuan kept shouting at the bathroom door. After waking up today, Wen Ning did not admit at all that he had promised him to be together again last night, insisting that he was confused for a moment.
Momentarily confused? She was confused, right? Faced with his questioning, Wen Ning ignored him and ran into the bathroom to take a shower. She shut him out ruthlessly and turned the water on to the maximum to cover up his angry voice.
Xiao Chongyuan kept nagging for a long time and got no response. He knocked on the door angrily, "You are cheating on my body!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the bathroom door was suddenly opened
Xiao Chongyuan choked for a moment, "That..."
"It's obviously me who suffers, right?" Wen Ning wiped his hair and walked out, walking into the kitchen barefoot, leaving wet footprints on the floor.
"Wear shoes, don't you know it's cold?" Xiao Chongyuan frowned and followed her. When he walked to the kitchen door, he saw her body proportions were so perfect. Every toe was white, tender and clean, with a light layer of pink.
"What are you looking at?"
"Nothing..." Only then did Xiao Chongyuan realize that he was staring at her feet.
"It's time for you to go to work." Wen Ning walked out again holding the ice cream.
"I won't go anywhere until you make it clear." Xiao Chongyuan followed Wen Ning to the sofa reluctantly, "You have to remarry anyway to get your certificate back. Seeing that the deadline set by your sister is coming soon, wouldn't it be a good idea for us to make a fake show?"
"We have a contract." Wen Ning
"Contract?"
"Yes, it's very clear in the contract. We will have a fake remarriage for three months. During this period, I will take care of your daily life. After the expiration of the term, we will not harm you." Wen Ning filled his mouth with a scoop of ice cream and chewed it with dissatisfaction.
In fact, she woke up in the middle of last night. She looked at the sleeping man next to her and thought about it for a long time before recalling what happened at night. He said that he wanted to start over. Could it be that the bad behavior he had done to her before was just wiped out? Although she was very moved to hear what he said...
Hearing what she said, Xiao Chongyuan knew that she was vomiting, so he shrugged and said, "I just said it casually. You know, I always like to lie... and tease you."
Wen Ning looked at him with a spoon in his mouth. He himself said that he liked to lie to her. Who knows if he wanted to lie to her again on a whim this time?
"Aning, why don't you speak?" Xiao Chongyuan's voice brought her thoughts back.
"I..." Wen Ning stirred the ice cream with a spoon and whispered, "I don't really want to remarry."
"Stop vomiting."
"I didn't." Wen Ning was a little annoyed.
"You also have feelings for me, right? Your reaction two nights ago said it all."
Xiao Chongyuan looked at her firmly, "You mistakenly called me your husband twice. Your subconscious cannot lie."
When Wen Ning was asked, he hugged the ice cream bucket tightly with both hands, as if he could no longer pretend to be indifferent.
Xiao Chongyuan looked at her confidently, "Remarry, Aning. This is what you want, isn't it?"
"No, that's not it!" As if he saw through it, Wen Ning burst out instantly, and her suddenly raised voice startled Xiao Chongyuan.
"Aning..."
"I don't want to experience such a cold marriage again." Wen Ning's shoulders trembled a little, "Don't act like you know me very well. If you really knew me, you should know that I didn't want a loveless marriage at all. Put away your confidence, you don't know, you don't know anything.road! "
"A Ning..." Xiao Chongyuan was surprised, but also felt a little heartbroken, "But I...I love you now. "He tried to put his hand on her trembling shoulders, but she moved away.
Wen Ning grabbed his shoulders and looked up, tears in his eyes full of accusations, "Is this enough? If you don't love me, you can easily divorce me. When you fall in love with me, I will happily come to remarry you. Xiao Chongyuan, I'm not that cheap! "
"That's not what I meant, but why do you... hate me so much? I thought you had feelings for me too. "
"No, I just hate myself, hate myself for not being able to hate you. "
Wen Ning's voice dropped again, and she looked away helplessly, taking another spoonful of ice cream and putting it into her mouth. The vanilla cream rubbed against her lips, and was quickly washed away by tears rolling down her face, "If you would have fallen in love with me two years ago, maybe I wouldn't have gone through so many difficult days. "She was crying while eating the ice cream.
Her mouth was full, but she couldn't swallow because she was choked, and her face turned pale because of the ice.
"Don't be like this, Aning. "Xiao Chongyuan reached out anxiously to grab the ice cream bucket, took out the toilet paper and held it under her lips, saying in a hoarse voice: "Spit it out, don't freeze yourself. "
Xiao Chongyuan looked over when he saw those eyes filled with tears. The accusations in his eyes made his heart tighten. Wen Ning looked at him and suddenly cried and choked a few times, spitting out all the ice cream in his mouth.
Without any resistance, she covered her face and started to cry. Xiao Chongyuan wanted to comfort her several times, but he didn't know how to speak.
After waiting for a while, Wen Ning's crying gradually weakened. She hugged her knees and kept sobbing, and said intermittently: "You once asked me, if Mona can bear it, why didn't I... bear with you more. She looked at one place with some confusion, "It's because I fell in love with you at that time, so I couldn't stand my husband's indifference. Do you know when I fell in love with you?" "
Wen Ning, who was lost in memories, actually raised a faint smile, "Actually, I also forgot, maybe it was when you asked me if I was hungry when we first met, or maybe after we got married, you told me that I actually looked beautiful when I smiled... Why didn't you love me then? When I learn to cook and do housework for you, won't you love me more? Your love was three years late. Why should I accept it when I finally let go of the past? "
Wen Ning's accusations were like knives piercing Xiao Chongyuan's heart. He was completely unaware of her feelings. He always thought that their views on this marriage were just that they were well matched.
It turns out that Wen Ning waited so hard for him to fall in love with her, but what about him? He was actually still blaming Wen Ning, blaming her for her sudden change of temperament, blaming her for deciding to divorce, no wonder Wen Ning was unwilling to endure it, because he was not worth it at all.
"I'm sorry. "Full of guilt and heartache, Xiao Chongyuan had nothing to say except an apology.
Wen Ning just shook his head, said nothing, stood up and walked into the guest room in silence.
This sudden confession made Xiao Chongyuan feel unprecedented fear. He was so afraid that Wen Ning would take revenge on him, so when he finally felt tempted, he left decisively again, letting him experience the feeling of waiting.
Only then did Xiao Chongyuan fully confirm his feelings for Wen Ning. He didn't want to leave her, and he didn't want to live a life without her again. It had become an undoubted reality that he fell in love with her.
An hour later, Xiao Chongyuan knocked lightly on the door of the guest room, but received no response. He tentatively turned the doorknob. After finding that the door was unlocked, he walked in quietly.
Wen Ning stood by the window, her fragile back making people feel distressed. Xiao Chongyuan walked over and involuntarily hugged her from behind, as if he was afraid that she would run away, but fortunately Wen Ning did not resist.
Xiao Chongyuan buried his head in Wen NingIn the hollow of his neck, he said in a hoarse voice: "It's all my fault. Give me another chance to love you well. I love you, Aning."
Xiao Chongyuan hugged her and spoke love words over and over again, his voice trembling uncontrollably.
Wen Ning looked at the man with red eyes behind her through the reflection in the window. She knew that she could not refuse him at all. Even if she said hysterically that she would not be fooled again, she also knew that she could not resist him.
